grammar.label: modals of deduction — present
grammar.meaning: how certain you are about a present situation

explanation.en: 'Must be' = I am almost sure it is true. 'Can't be' = I am almost sure it is not. 'Might be' = it is possible.
explanation.uz: 'must be' — deyarli aminman, shunday. 'can't be' — deyarli aminman, unday emas. 'might be' — bo'lishi mumkin.

grammar.positive_example: She isn't answering — she must be busy.
grammar.negative_example: She isn't answering — she must to be busy.

l1_notes.uz: 'mustn't' taqiq bildiradi, 'ehtimol emas' degani emas — bu chalkashlik juda keng tarqalgan.

grammar.label: modals of deduction — past
grammar.form: must have / might have / can't have + past participle
grammar.meaning: how certain you are about a past event

explanation.en: Add 'have + past participle' to move the guess into the past: 'He must have missed the bus.'
explanation.uz: Taxminni o'tmishga ko'chirish uchun 'have + III shakl' qo'shiladi: 'He must have missed the bus.'

grammar.positive_example: The lights are off — they must have gone out.
grammar.negative_example: The lights are off — they must went out.

l1_notes.uz: 'have' dan keyin III shakl kelishi shart, o'tgan zamon shakli emas.

phonology.label: Sentence stress — content words carry the beat
Weak forms in fast speech — was, were, been, have, has, had

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Bobur is not answering. He must be at training.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: At this hour? It can't be training. It finished at six.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Then he might be on the bus.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: Possibly. Or he must have forgotten his phone again.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: That is the likely answer. He forgot it two times last week.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: There is no proof, but the evidence suggests that.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: It can't have been stolen, can it?

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: I doubt it. He would have called from somewhere.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: True. My first instinct was that something had happened.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: It usually turns out to be the easy explanation.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: You are right. He must have left it in the changing room.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: He will find it tomorrow and say nothing about it.
